title: Tensor-route computation on K-flat pullback representatives
statement: For prime ℓ, normed E over ℚ_ℓ, f:X→Y, an explicit ordinary monoidal structure m, a proof that pullback preserves flat objects, and a homotopy complex P whose ordinary pullback is K-flat, the residue exchange tensor comparison equation holds with m-induced derived monoidal structure.

proof.text: Expand the derived tensor comparison on the K-flat representative, normalize the fixed coefficient presentation through the symmetry isomorphism and apply its counit identity; identify the remaining ordinary composite with the tensor-model map.

proof_origin.note: Resolving-class component of the transport calculation; arbitrary P is handled by the separate descent node.

lean.statement: theorem integralResidue_tensorRoute_kFlat {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.Monoidal) (hFlat : (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.PreservesFlat) (P : HomotopyCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ)) (hP : ((f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧).kFlatMap P) : letI := residueExchangePullMonoidal ℓ E f m hFlat (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).map ((residueExchangeTensorIso ℓ E Y).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y) ≫ residueExchangeTensorModelTarget ℓ E f P = residueExchangeTensorModelMap ℓ E f P
